release_notes: The till, the shop web, and stored reports use the same sales, credit, repayment, and profit figures. A deposit on a credit sale is money received once, and a later repayment is not a second sale. Profit uses the cost recorded on the sale. The portal Backup page no longer pretends to upload a shop database. A remote backup command says when the till is signed out, and a failed upload does not replace the last stored backup.
